Priya (ml-owner): Hey team — intake for hazel-14b weights uploaded by external contributor. Need a quick usage-rights audit before we start quant experiments. TL;DR: source repo says 'research use only' and there's a separate MODEL_CARD.md.
Sam (infra): Do we have the exact license text? paste the link please.
Priya (ml-owner): https://mirror.example/hazel-14b/weights MODEL_CARD.md snippet: 'Non-commercial research use only; redistribution of modified weights requires consent.'
Ava (research): That sounds like a non-commercial restriction. That will block Hosted API listing and public redistribution. We can still bench privately but need clarity on whether Dedicated/Private deployments are allowed for paying customers.
legal-bot: Quick checklist: 1) Confirm canonical license file in repo. 2) Check contributor CLA / third-party weights. 3) Escalate if export-control flags in model card. 4) Decide allowed deployment surfaces (hosted/dedicated/private).
Tom (security): Also check embedded tokenizer license and any pretrained subcomponents (e.g., images/text encoders). Sometimes those have separate terms.
Priya (ml-owner): Action plan: (a) I'll open an issue with the contributor to request a commercial license or a redistribution addendum. (b) Ava, can you run a small eval on quant-8bit in our private cluster to measure regression risk? (c) Sam, block any auto-promotion into Hosted until legal signs off.
Ava (research): Will run evals today — I'll use a 512-seqlen eval set and compare FP16 baseline vs Q8 and Q4. Will post losses + rouge/bertscore snippets.
Sam (infra): Temporary flagging done: model is tagged "no-hosted" in model-catalog. Also disabled public artifact publishing from CI.
legal-bot: Note: 'research use only' typically prevents commercial hosting. If contributor refuses, approved path: (1) Only allow Private (customer-managed) deployments with a no-redistribution clause; (2) Add explicit end-user notice and restrict model snapshots in backups; (3) Add audit entry and customer acceptance form.
Tom (security): For Private deployments, we should ensure our onboarding template inserts KMS restrictions and an acknowledgement that we won't distribute weights. Update the template if needed.
Priya (ml-owner): Quick question — is quantization considered "modification" under their terms? If yes, then redistribution of quantized weights might be disallowed.
legal-bot: Good catch. Many licenses treat derived weights as modifications. Treat quantized checkpoints as derivatives until legal says otherwise.
Ava (research): For now I'll run transient quantization experiments that do not persist to artifact storage — ephemeral runs only. Results logged, but no checkpoint uploads.
Sam (infra): I'll add a CI guard to prevent artifact upload when model has tag "no-redistribute". Patch going out in ~2h.
Priya (ml-owner): If contributor responds with an explicit commercial license, we can proceed to broader testing and consider Hosted listing after approval. Else, fallback = Private-only with strict customer terms.
Tom (security): Also recommend we add an entry to our export-control checklist: if model trained on restricted datasets or with certain crypto libs, might need additional review.
Ava (research): I'll attach the eval summary once runs complete. Expect a short report with perf deltas and a small output-quality sample.
Priya (ml-owner): Thanks all. I'll draft the contributor request language and ping Legal for a reuse addendum. Leaving this thread pinned to the model intake ticket. :thumbsup:
